name: sqlite-table-viewer
displayName: SQLite Editor & Viewer, SQLite3 Database Browser (Edit Cells, CSV Import)
description: Free, no paywall, no sign-in, works offline. Opens .db and .sqlite files read-only; click Enable editing to change cells and rows, run INSERT or UPDATE, and import a 1M-row CSV. Every change is staged with Undo, and Save makes a backup and writes atomically. Reads the -wal file, live reload, JSON and BLOB cells, export to CSV, JSON or SQL.

sqliteTableViewer.maxFileSizeMB.description: The whole database is loaded into memory. Larger files show a message instead of loading. Editing has its own, lower limit (editMaxFileSizeMB).

sqliteTableViewer.copyMaxRows.description: Copy at most this many rows to the clipboard at once.

sqliteTableViewer.exportMaxRows.description: Export at most this many rows to a CSV or JSON file.

sqliteTableViewer.autoReload.markdownDescription: Reload the view when the database file or its `-wal` file changes on disk. The table, sort, filters and scroll position stay. Turn it off with `false` to get a Reload notice instead.

sqliteTableViewer.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after 3 databases opened without an error on 2 different days. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

sqliteTableViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the right end of the viewer's status line. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

sqliteTableViewer.editMaxFileSizeMB.description: Editing is refused for larger files, because the whole database and a second copy for the save must fit in memory. Larger files still open read-only.

enumDescriptions: name.db.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.bak in the same folder as the database
sqliteTableViewer.backupLocation.description: Where Save puts the backup copy of the database before it writes.

sqliteTableViewer.enforceForeignKeys.description: While editing, check foreign keys (PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON): a change that breaks one is refused, and Save checks the whole file.

sqliteTableViewer.showProFeatures.markdownDescription: Show the Zovo Pro tools (the DB tools button, compare, ER diagram, export all tables) and the Zovo license commands. Off hides them unless a license is active. Free features are not affected.

sqliteTableViewer.compareMaxStatements.markdownDescription: Compare databases (Zovo Pro): the sync script stops after this many statements. A script that stops ends with `ROLLBACK`, so it never makes half a change.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with SQLite Editor
walkthroughs.description: Open SQLite files read-only, browse tables, then edit cells and rows, import CSV and save safely.

steps.title: Open a database
steps.description:
Click any .db, .sqlite, .sqlite3, .db3, .s3db, .sl3, .vscdb or .gpkg file. For other names, right-click the file and pick "Open in SQLite Editor".
[Find a database](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.db%22%5D)

steps.title: Sort, filter and read the schema
steps.description: Pick a table on the left. Click a header to sort and type under it to filter. The Schema tab shows columns, keys, foreign keys and the CREATE statement.

media.altText: The orders table filtered to paid orders over 1,000 dollars and sorted by total, next to the list of tables, views, indexes and triggers.

steps.title: Edit cells and rows, then Save
steps.description:
Click Enable editing. Double-click a cell or press Enter to change it, use + Row, Duplicate and Delete rows, or run INSERT and UPDATE in the SQL box. Every change waits in the pending list with Undo. Save checks constraints, makes a backup copy and replaces the file in one step.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22sqliteTableViewer%22%5D)

steps.title: Import a CSV or TSV file
steps.description:
Use Import CSV in the toolbar, or right-click a .csv file and pick Import CSV into a new SQLite database. Pick the delimiter and encoding, map the columns, and watch the progress bar. A 1M-row file takes seconds and can be cancelled.
[Import CSV into a new database](command:sqliteTableViewer.csvToNewDatabase)

steps.title: Look inside a cell
steps.description:
Double-click a cell or press Enter. JSON shows as a tree, images show as pictures, and float32 BLOBs show as vectors with their size and norm.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22sqliteTableViewer%22%5D)

steps.title: Files that often come with SQLite databases
steps.description:
If your project also has spreadsheets and CSV files or JSON files, these free Zovo extensions open them. A link opens the extension page, and you choose there whether to install it.
[XLSX and CSV Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.table-viewer-vscode%22%5D)
[JSON Tree Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.zovo-json-tree-viewer%22%5D)
